name: dailies
description: Dailies — scope-bound, trust-aware release decisions for AI changes: promote, block, or inconclusive.

plugins.name: dailies
plugins.description: Gate an AI change on declared evidence before it advances. One skill walks a coding agent through creating a digest-pinned starter corpus with dailies init, running the release evaluation, and reading report.md and the exit codes as promote, block, or inconclusive without treating missing or untrusted evidence as a pass.
